C H A P T E R O U T L I N E
Acute traumatic events can result in impairment of nutritional
intake and may require alternate paths for nutritional support. 
Closed head injuries have been shown to represent signiﬁ cant
metabolic stress, so nutritional support is critical for a positive
outcome. Many chronic neurological disorders are treated with
